heading: Cover letter
body:
I am a Cape Town production software engineer with eight years of PHP. If you are hiring a senior PHP / Laravel engineer who can sit with a client, spec the work, cost it, plan it, and ship it with a small team until they are happy — that is the job I already do. Contract title at Silicon Overdrive is Software Developer. The work is production engineer on the clients I own.

Indawo is mine end to end: site and server (not the Azure hardware). I coordinate a project manager, a senior developer, and a mid developer; they do not report to me on paper. Pull requests, then an automated health window after deploy. When the on-prem CentOS box died over a weekend I Dockerised the legacy PHP app, fixed publishing, and brought production back. SAWIS BI is different: I am tech lead on the PHP site and database, not their pipelines or servers.

I also work as an AWS DevOps engineer on those systems — Docker, deploys, existing EC2/RDS/Lambda/IAM. I am not the account architect and I am not a platform team. Monitoring and logging are still basic: we debug availability when it breaks. I want a proper SRE seat next: industry Kubernetes, Linux, containers, monitoring, logging, networking. I do not have that cluster at work, so I run k3s/k3d and a streaming stack in a homelab, and Terraform on a freelance fleet with a friend (two years each).

I like hard problems and I am easy to work with. SAST (UTC+2), flexible hours while I finish a BSc in Information Technology at Eduvos beside a full working week.

Thank you for your time. I would welcome a conversation.
